description: Per-site I-9 compliance configuration. Controls whether document copies are stored (uniformity rule), E-Verify enrolment, employer defaults for Section 2, and reminder lead times.

fields.description: If enabled, document copies MUST be stored for ALL employees (uniformity rule). Mixing — copies for some, not for others — is a discrimination claim.
fields.label: Store Document Copies

fields.description: If enrolled in E-Verify, document copies are mandatory and store_document_copies is forced on.
fields.label: Enrolled in E-Verify

fields.description: OFF, and leaving it off is a real answer rather than a gap. With it off this site stores the last four digits of an SSN and nothing more, which is everything the forms it prints need. Switch it on ONLY if this operation runs E-Verify: E-Verify submits nine digits and cannot be run from four. The number is written to Frappe's encrypted password table, no tool reads it back, and turning this switch off blanks it on the next save of each form rather than at the moment of the switch.
fields.label: Store Full SSN (Encrypted)

fields.description: Who may sign a federal employment form on this employer's behalf. EMPTY MEANS UNRESTRICTED, which is what a fresh install is and is deliberate: a site that has never configured a roster keeps the pre-v0.48.0 behaviour and submit_i9_section_2 takes whatever verifier_name it is given. Add one row and the roster starts being enforced for every form it covers — so the first row is the switch, and adding a row that leaves out the person doing the verifying locks them out. It governs Form W-4's employer block as well as Form I-9's Section 2, which is why it lives beside the employer defaults rather than in a doctype of its own.
fields.label: Authorized Signers

fields.description: OFF, AND IT MUST SHIP OFF. With the roster EMPTY this site is unrestricted — submit_i9_section_2 accepts whatever verifier_name it is given — and that is deliberate, because a version that started refusing signatures on migrate would break the I-9 flow on every farm running this app. This switch closes that opening, and turning it on BEFORE the roster has rows would refuse every Section 2 on the farm. The order is: add the authorized signers (add_authorized_signer), confirm list_authorized_signers reports configured=true, THEN switch this on. Once on, an unconfigured roster is a refusal that names add_authorized_signer instead of a silent acceptance of any name the caller typed.
fields.label: Refuse Employer Signatures When No Roster Is Configured

fields.description: Days before a document expiration date to raise a warning.
fields.label: Days Before Document Expiration

fields.description: Days before retention-until date to flag an I-9 as eligible for destruction.
fields.label: Days Before Destruction Eligibility

name: I-9 Settings
